immutability_rule: Do not change acceptance criteria after examining test results. Requirement changes need a new version and written rationale before affected evaluation; retain v1.0.
data_boundary: V1 and V2 remain not evaluated because eligible local video/ground truth is unavailable. V3 pilot clips are training-split development data, not held-out test data. Missing data does not waive or redefine requirements.
acceptance_areas: V1 mixed birds+drone expected classes, tracks, per-drone review alerts, and summary consistency
V2 simultaneous multiple drones keep distinct identities and alert/evidence per track
V3 bird-only flock creates zero UAV alerts and reports misses/uncertainty honestly
Shared detection, tracking, alert timing, dashboard reconciliation, thermal, and authorization rules are specified in locked document
Metrics and data-split rules are specified before model tuning
